messages:
Noah: Weekend pop quiz  sunrise brekkie on the pier (6:30am) or board-game-cafe afternoon (2pm)? whos in? :sunrise_over_mountains: :game_die:
Zara: ooh both sound fun. but im dragging for 6:30. cafe for me.
Diego: pier if there's a good latte cart. ill bring the thermos and a portable French press.
Talia: board-game cafe! i need soft lighting and snacks. also i have the new cooperative game to try.
Noah: @Diego french press + sunrise = chefs kiss. anyone want to split breakfast bagels?
Zara: i can pick up bagels if we go cafe later (less at-5am coordination).
Diego: vote: pier 1, cafe 2. low-key leaning cafe.
Talia: cafe 3. plus: i'll bring extra board sleeves and the new expansion.
Noah: hmm looks like cafe wins. maybe we do a small crew for an earlier coffee run and larger group at 2pm?
BuildBot: Event created: "Board Game Cafe Afternoon" at 02:00 PM, RSVP: Noah, Zara, Talia, Diego.
Noah: plan: small sunrise espresso for anyone who's brave (meet 7am at lobby), big group 2pm at Dice & Dough.
Zara: @Noah i'll do sunrise if someone promises a double shot.
Diego: promise. also bringing trail mix in case our snack options are terrible.
Talia: sweet i'll coordinate which games to bring. anyone allergic to nuts?
Zara: allergic to tree nuts, thanks for checking.
Noah: noted. i'll swap to nut-free snack pack.
Diego: see you weekend crew :raised_hands:
